paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: Comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates. Due to the significant difference in values between high and low sparsity rates, we use the logarithmic results for comparison.

annotations.annotation: 该条形图通过比较两种剪枝配置 (Dynamic Layerwise Pruning (DLP))（每输出(Per-Output)（蓝色）和每层(Per-Layer)（橙色））在不同稀疏率(sparsity) 下的困惑度 (perplexity)，展示了动态逐层剪枝 (DLP) 对大型语言模型性能的影响。横轴按从 10% 到 80% 的递增顺序显示不同的稀疏率，并标记为“稀疏率”。纵轴表示困惑度，标记为“困惑度”，对数刻度范围从 10^1 到 10^3。对于每个稀疏率，成对的条形分别代表每输出（左图，蓝色）和每层（右图，橙色）的剪枝方法 (Pruning method)。在这两种配置中，当稀疏率在 10-50% 之间时，困惑度都保持在相对较低水平。在 60% 的稀疏率下，每层方法（橙色）的困惑度达到 10^1，而每输出方法（蓝色）的困惑度略低。两种方法的稀疏率都从 70% 开始急剧增加，并在 80% 时达到图表的最大值约10^3。条形的高度与较低稀疏度相比显著增加在 70% 和 80% 的稀疏度下。

Die Abbildung ist ein Balkendiagramm, das die Perplexitätswerte für „Per-Output“ und „Per-Layer“ in Abhängigkeit von unterschiedlichen Sparsity-Raten zeigt. Die horizontale Achse ist mit „Sparsity Rate“ beschriftet und reicht von 10 % bis 80 % in Schritten von 10 %. Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Perplexity“ beschriftet und in einer logarithmischer Skalierung dargestellt, mit beschrifteten Markierungen bei 10^1, 10^2 und 10^3. Für jede Sparsity-Rate wird ein Balkenpaar nebeneinander dargestellt. Die blauen Balken, die jeweils links im Paar stehen, repräsentieren „Per-Output“, während die orangefarbenen Balken rechts daneben „Per-Layer“ darstellen. Die Höhe der Balken nimmt mit steigender Sparsity-Rate zu. Bis zu einer Sparsity von 50 % bleiben alle Werte unterhalb von 10^1 . Bei 60 % liegt der orange Balken leicht über 10^1, während der blaue noch darunter bleibt. Die Balken bei 70 % sind höher und überschreiten die 10^1 -Marke. Bei 80 % erreichen die Balken die höchsten Werte: Der orangefarbene Balken nähert sich der 10^3 -Marke, während der blaue knapp darunter liegt.

The bar chart illustrates the comparison of perplexity values of "Per-Output" and "Per-Layer" at different sparsity rates.The horizontal axis labeled "Sparsity rates", ordered sequentially from 10% to 80%, in increments of 10%. The vertical axis labeled "Perplexity", with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3, marked with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals corresponding to powers of 10. The chart features pair of bars for each sparsity rate with blue bar followed by orange bar, with blue bars representing Per-Output and orange bars representing Per-Layer. The approximate perplexity values of the bars increase with higher sparsity rates, starting from around 2 at 10% sparsity, and approaching 10^3 as sparsity reaches 80%. The values remains below 10^2 till 70% sparsity. At 70% and 80% sparsity, the bars exhibit a notable increase in height compared to the lower sparsity rates. At 60% the orange bar is slightly above 10^1 while the blue bar is still below 10^1. At 50%, 60%, 70% and 80% the orange bars are taller than the blue bars. The bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond the increasing sparsity rate. A legend positioned in the top-left corner of the figure defines each bar with "Per-Output" or "Per-Layer" and it's color.

Фигурата представлява стълбовидна диаграма, която показва стойностите на перплекситет за конфигурациите „На изход“ (*Per-Output*) и „На слой“ (*Per-Layer*) в зависимост от различни степени на разреждане (*Sparsity Rate*). Хоризонталната ос е означена като „Степен на разреждане“ и обхваща стойности от 10 % до 80 % с крачка от 10 %. Вертикалната ос е означена като „Перплекситет“ и е представена с логаритмична скала, с означени стойности при 10^1, 10^2 и 10^3. За всяка степен на разреждане са изобразени по две съседни стълбчета. Сините стълбчета, които се намират вляво във всяка двойка, представят конфигурацията „На изход“, докато оранжевите стълбчета вдясно представят конфигурацията „На слой“. Височината на стълбчетата нараства с увеличаването на степента на разреждане. До 50 % всички стойности остават под 10^1. При 60 % оранжевото стълбче леко надвишава 10^1, докато синьото остава под тази граница. При 70 % и двете стълбчета са по-високи и надвишават 10^1. При 80 % се наблюдават най-високите стойности: оранжевото стълбче доближава 10^3, а синьото е малко под тази стойност.

The bar chart illustrates the comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates. The X-axis contains categories labeled as "Sparsity Rate," ordered sequentially from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%. The vertical axis is labeled "Perplexity" and represents the perplexity with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3, marked with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals corresponding to powers of 10. The chart features grouped bars for each category, with blue bars representing the Per-Output configuration and orange bars representing the Per-Layer configuration. The approximate values of the bars increase with higher sparsity rates, starting from around 2 at 10% sparsity to over 10^2 and approaching 10^3 as sparsity reaches 80%. There are notably equal values of both categories till 30%, but from 40% sparsity rate orange bar(Per-Layer) slowly starts increasing, and at 70% and 80% sparsity, the bars exhibit a notable difference with the orange bar being on top compared to the lower sparsity rates. The bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond the increasing sparsity rate, and none of the bars are visually emphasized with special shading, bolding, or outlining. The legend is positioned in the top left corner of the plot area, featuring the color with the corresponding characteristic.

The bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and two forms of perplexity; per-output and per-layer perplexity post-pruning in LLMs. The horizontal axis is labelled "Sparsity Rate" and ranges from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%. The vertical axis labeled "Perplexity" has a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3, with tick labels corresponding to powers of 10. The chart features grouped bars for each category, with blue bars representing the Per-Output configuration and orange bars representing the Per-Layer configuration. The approximate values of the bars increase with higher sparsity rates, starting from close to zero at 10% sparsity to over 100 and approaching 1000 as sparsity reaches 80%. At 70% and 80% sparsity, the bars exhibit a notable increase in height compared to the lower sparsity rates.

The bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity, depicted through two different configurations: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled as sparsity rates, ordered sequentially from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with the axis labeled as "Sparsity Rate." The vertical axis represents the perplexity, labeled "Perplexity," with a logarithmic scale ranging from (10^1) to (10^3), marked with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals corresponding to powers of 10. The chart features grouped bars for each category, with blue bars representing the Per-Output configuration and orange bars representing the Per-Layer configuration. The approximate perplexity values remain low and fairly constant between 10% and 40% sparsity rate but begin to increase exponentially starting from around 50% sparsity rate. Perplexity for both Per-Output and Per-Layer reach an approximate perplexity value of 10, and by 80% sparsity rate the perplexity for both Per-Output and Per-Layer configurations are close to 10^3. Perplexity of both configurations are nearly identical between 10% and 40% sparsity rate, but the Per-Layer configuration has slightly higher perplexity value from 50% onwards, with the difference in values between the two configurations highest at 70% sparsity rate.
